tests.expect: The CLI and PR verification preserve setup and accurately report check results, behaviour, failures, and evidence

adoption.description: Adopt projects and install or update bundled skills while preserving user setup
adoption.entry: groundwork init / groundwork install / groundwork update

coverage.description: Account for every planned requirement using checks and retained observations

catalogue.description: Discover behaviours and enforce applicable project invariants

drivers.description: Exercise lifecycle drivers, retain repeated trials, and compare source revisions

pr-verification.description: Verify a PR against a frozen plan and report results in the importing repository

complete-evidence.description: Missing planned requirements or declared evidence cannot produce a passing verification result
